trinkets.trinketDescription: You enter a small room filled with books and relics of old, a Cracked Key lays strewn accross a long forgotten writing desk... maybe this could be of use somewhere...?
trinkets.puzzleDescription: You enter what looks to be bedroom, weathered by time. You spot a crooked chest of drawers lingering to the right of you, one of the drawers emits a strange energy. The drawer is locked... maybe you could find a key somewhere?
trinkets.solvedDescription: You enter the old bedroom, the drawer hangs open. There's no more you can gain here.
trinkets.correctTrinket: You use the cracked key. After some fumbling with the lock, the drawer slides open!
